question: โครงและทางไปต่อ/ย้อนกลับชุดนี้ใช้ได้ไหมครับ? 1. ใช้ตามนี้ — รับโครง Login ชุดนี้ 2. ปรับช่องแรก — การกรอกและเลือกวิธีเข้าใช้ 3. ปรับหน้าถัดไป — หน้า OTP หรือรหัสผ่าน
version: Home Auth Current Login Structure G2-r30

accepted_scope.entry: Displayed shared email/phone identifier, Continue, explicit password entry, Google entry and Register link.
accepted_scope.email_OTP: Displayed active six-slot normal entry with auto verification at six digits, consolidated instruction and countdown-only inactive resend button.
accepted_scope.email_password: Displayed explicit email/password alternative and switch to email OTP.
accepted_scope.phone_password: Displayed phone/password branch without email/SMS OTP action; Forgot still enters accepted email-link recovery.
accepted_scope.navigation: Continue routes according to current identifier/method; Back/Edit returns to identifier in the active flow. Merely going back/editing does not request OTP.
accepted_scope.methods: Retain previously selected email OTP primary, explicit email password, phone password and Google.
accepted_scope.boundary: Four displayed structures/routes only; accepted error/return states remain separate and whole G2 is not approved.
